correctness.rationale: Cyclic ordered zero gaps (a,b,c), total N=n-3, parametrize the rotation-only source classes. One-deletions give the unordered gap pair {g,N-g}, so two different gap values coincide only when they sum to N and the other gap is zero. Zero-deletions are positive-coordinate decrements and have a different weight from the one-deletions. To compare two decrements, cycle the positions to the first two: (a-1,b,c) cannot equal (a,b-1,c) directly, and the two nontrivial rotations force either a=b=c or a=b=c+1, respectively. Thus all-equal positive gaps lose two outputs, type (t,t,t-1) loses one (including t=1), and otherwise the positive-gap deletions are distinct. The resulting buckets count N=0, the one-positive/all-equal cases, the single (1,1,0) case, N-1 ordered positive pairs with a uniquely placed zero less that case plus the t>=2 exceptions, positive two-equal triples less those exceptions, and all-positive distinct triples modulo three-cycle rotation. Counting each by total gap sum and multiplying by z^3 gives all six GFs. The last begins with (1,2,3) in two orientations at n=9 and has coefficient n^2/6+O(n); the remaining classes together are O(n). Fresh literal bit-deletion histograms matched for n=3 through 30, with direct checks on 981 small gap orbits and a gap enumeration versus rational coefficients through n=57. Replay procedure and results: /workspace/branches/b6b33260-f8dc-4adb-adf1-05380715e304/independent-check.md.
residual_risks: Computation is bounded; the rotation comparison and orbit counts, not the finite table, justify all lengths. Reflection, complementation, other contents and multiple deletions are excluded.

Three-marker border, sharp outdegree and fractional packing comparisons
value.rationale: Three ones give a natural small-content class in which clockwise order matters and distinct positive-gap decrements can coalesce modulo rotation. The full distribution explains the exact scarcity and mechanism of these collisions, including the isolated three-output case, and distinguishes generic six-output behavior from the lower-degree sources. This is useful for analyzing the cyclic one-deletion graph independently of its maximum degree or its packing optimum, rather than merely renaming a previously counted column.
residual_risks: This classification does not settle optimal codes or the higher-weight deletion-shadow laws.
